text:
maya: quick preflight — planning to pin runtime v3.2.1 for the midnight window. This includes console schema v2.4, router header-split flag, and API v2 toggle. Need a short cross-service handshake.
alex: timeline? are we doing a staggered pin or simultaneous?
simon: prefer staggered: runtime -> api -> router -> console so KV eviction and cache warm-up happens first.
rachel: rollback criteria? if console schema fails validation we need a clear short-circuit to previous schema and unpin.
maya: target window 00:30-01:30 UTC. Staggered with 5m gap between steps. Rollback if >5% 5xxs or latency p50 jumps >250ms over baseline for 10m.
deploy-bot: @channel deploy plan created: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Pins: runtime:v3.2.1, api:v2.0.4, router:header-split:on, console:schema:v2.4. Canary schedule: 00:30, 00:40, 00:50. See /deploy/1792 for details.
alex: runtime change includes batching window increase and kv-ttl tweak, right?
simon: yes. batching: "max_batch_ms=8" and kv-ttl from 300->600 for warm-up. I pushed the change to ops-config and added a canary flag: runtime.canary_warm=true
ops-oncall: please confirm drain plan for old variants. we'll need a 10m pre-drain and post-check for shard evictions.
maya: noted. drain: pre-drain 00:20 -> 00:30, post-check 01:30 -> 01:40.
rachel: console migration step: schema apply is non-blocking but clients will get a deprecation header. If any schema errors reported by the validator pipeline during canary -> abort to pinned schema and open rollback.
alex: can we add a quick smoke checklist?
simon: adding short list: 1) runtime metrics stable (p50/p95 tokens), 2) api error rate <0.5%, 3) router drops <0.1%, 4) console validator green.
maya: smoke check acknowledged. I'll run the preflight dry-run at 23:45 UTC and post results here.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary started at 00:30 UTC for runtime:v3.2.1 -> 10% traffic. monitor: /dash/releases/runtime-3-2-1-canary.
ops-oncall: noticed minor p95 bump (+60ms) during first injection, under threshold. continuing.
rachel: console validator reported one minor enum mismatch in 10 requests to canary — not fatal but looks like old client. pushing a soft-warning to release notes.
alex: ok to proceed to 50% at 00:40?
simon: wait 10m more to see kv warming. also check GPU memory stable.
maya: agree. moving to 50% at 00:45.
deploy-bot: canary -> 50% at 00:45. router flag rollout in progress: header-split staged for half the gateways.
ops-oncall: eviction logs look clean. no shard thrash.
rachel: console schema validator passes after minor client fallback; keeping schema pinned but allowing gradual client update.
alex: all good from API side, no increased 5xxs.
simon: runtime GPU memory and batch latencies nominal. proceeding.
maya: rolling to 100% at 00:55.
deploy-bot: rollout complete at 00:55. Pins officially updated.
ops-oncall: post-rollout checks for 20m, then clear.
rachel: updating release notes: "Runtime v3.2.1 pinned; console schema v2.4 (soft-warning to old clients); router header-split enabled; API v2 toggle on."
maya: thumbs up. If anything spikes, rollback plan is: unpin runtime (force traffic back), disable router flag, revert api toggle.
alex: can we add a quick rollback command snippet here?
simon: paste: ```/deploy rollback --service runtime --to-version v3.1.9 && /feature toggle set router header-split off && /deploy rollback --service api --to-version v2.0.2```
rachel: thanks. capturing in release notes + ops runbook.
maya: excellent coordination everyone. I'll close the thread after post-check. :tada:
